timeline.home.description: The name of the home timeline (the posts of the accounts the reader follows), for assistive technology.

timeline.new_posts.defaultMessage: {count, plural, one {# new post} other {# new posts}}
timeline.new_posts.description: The button over the top of the home timeline or a list's timeline while new posts wait or went in above the reader; pressing it shows them at the top. count is how many.

timeline.new_posts_missed.description: The button over the home timeline's top when posts may have been missed (after a reconnection); pressing it reads the newest posts again and shows them at the top.

timeline.local.description: The name of the local timeline (the public posts of this server's people), for assistive technology.

timeline.federated.description: The name of the federated timeline (the public posts this server knows from every server), for assistive technology.

timeline.tag.description: The name of a hashtag's timeline, for assistive technology. name is the hashtag without #.

timeline.tag_back.description: The button at the top of a hashtag's screen that goes back to where the reader came from.

timeline.tag_follow.description: The button at the end of a hashtag's title that follows it, so that its posts join the reader's home timeline.

timeline.tag_following.description: The button at the end of a hashtag's title while the reader follows it; pressing it stops following.

timeline.tag_follow_failed.defaultMessage: {follow, select, follow {Following #{name}} other {Unfollowing #{name}}} did not finish.
timeline.tag_follow_failed.description: The notice at the bottom of the page when following a hashtag, or unfollowing it, got no answer from the server (the network), beside Try again. The button stays as it was. follow is follow or unfollow; name is the hashtag without #.

timeline.tag_empty.defaultMessage: No posts with #{name} yet. Posts with #{name} that reach this server show here.
timeline.tag_empty.description: In place of a hashtag's posts when it has none. name is the hashtag without #.

timeline.lists.description: The name of the index of the reader's lists, for assistive technology.

timeline.lists_title.description: The title at the top of the index of the reader's lists, beside the list glyph.

timeline.lists_loading.description: In place of the reader's lists while they are being fetched.

timeline.lists_failed.defaultMessage: The lists could not be loaded.
timeline.lists_failed.description: In place of the reader's lists when fetching them failed; a retry action follows it.

timeline.lists_empty.defaultMessage: No lists yet. Your lists show here, each with the posts of its members.
timeline.lists_empty.description: In place of the reader's lists when they have made none.

timeline.list_members.description: How many accounts are in a list, under its name in the index and beside its title on its screen.

timeline.list_back.description: The button at the top of a list's screen that goes back to the index of the reader's lists.

timeline.list.description: The name of a list's timeline, for assistive technology. name is the list's name, as the reader wrote it.

timeline.list_loading.description: In place of a list's screen while the list is being fetched.

timeline.list_failed.defaultMessage: The list could not be loaded.
timeline.list_failed.description: In place of a list's screen when fetching the list failed; Try again follows it.

timeline.list_gone.description: In place of a list's screen when the server has no such list: the reader deleted it, on this or another device.

timeline.list_empty.defaultMessage: No posts from this list's members yet. When they post, their posts show here.
timeline.list_empty.description: In place of a list's posts when its members have none.

timeline.retry.description: The action after a failure to load the reader's lists, or a list, which fetches it again.

timeline.bookmarks.description: The name of the column of the posts the reader bookmarked, for assistive technology.

timeline.bookmarks_empty.defaultMessage: No bookmarks yet. Posts you bookmark show here.
timeline.bookmarks_empty.description: In place of the reader's bookmarks when they have none.
